title: FileAgentSchema

source_id.title: Source Id
source_id.description: Deprecated: Use `folder_id` field instead. Unique identifier of the source.

is_open.title: Is Open
is_open.description: True if the agent currently has the file open.

visible_content.title: Visible Content
visible_content.description: Portion of the file the agent is focused on (may be large).

last_accessed_at.title: Last Accessed At
last_accessed_at.description: UTC timestamp of the agent's most recent access to this file.

start_line.title: Start Line
start_line.description: Starting line number (1-indexed) when file was opened with line range.

end_line.title: End Line
end_line.description: Ending line number (exclusive) when file was opened with line range.

id.title: Id
id.description: Human-readable identifier for this file-agent relationship in the file

description: File-Agent relationship with human-readable ID for agent file
